newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviewing GE, United Technologies engine deal.
newsitem.headline: EU reviewing GE, United Technologies engine deal.

text.p: The European Commission said Friday it was reviewing a joint venture between General Electric Co.'s aircraft engines unit and the Pratt & Whitney division of United Technologies Corp.

P&W and General Electric Aircraft Engines have formed a venture through which they will jointly design, develop, produce, market, sell and support a new aircraft engine for larger versions of 747-400 planes being developed by Boeing Co.

The commission, the European Union's executive body, said in a statement that the deal was submitted for clearance in September under EU rules that ban anti-competitive behaviour and abuse of dominant position.
Although both companies are based in the United States, they do business in the 15-nation EU.
There is no strict deadline to rule on the deal, but the commission tries to inform companies involved in so-called cooperative joint ventures of its findings within two months of notification.
It invited interested parties to comment within 10 days.
